subtitle: Five connected parts turn expertise into a repeatable content loop.

steps.title: Build a source of truth
steps.description: Keep your strongest ideas, stories, proof and offers in one trusted library.

steps.title: Capture useful angles
steps.description: Turn recurring questions and observations into specific content angles.

steps.title: Route ideas by format
steps.description: Match each angle to the post, video, email or infographic that serves it best.

steps.title: Run a consistent cadence
steps.description: Publish from the system without forcing every idea into the same template.

steps.title: Feed signals back in
steps.description: Use replies, saves and qualified conversations to improve future angles.

footerLeft: Build a system, not a queue.
caption: Most content systems are really just publishing queues. A useful system keeps the source, angles, formats, cadence and feedback connected. That is what makes the output improve instead of merely increasing. This map shows the five parts. Save it before building your next content workflow.
